# The below Data Identifiers (DIDs) are supported by CB-ME for the ReadDataByIdentifier (SID: 0x22) service: {#the-below-data-identifiers-dids-are-supported-by-cb-me-for-the-readdatabyidentifier-sid-0x22-service .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

 

+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+----------------+
| DID            | Description                                      | Session                                     | Security Level |
|                |                                                  +---------+-------------+---------------------+                |
|                |                                                  | Default | Programming | Extended Diagnostic |                |
+================+==================================================+=========+=============+=====================+================+
| 0xF186         | ActiveDiagnosticSessionDataIdentifier            | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF190         | VIN                                              | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF198         | repairShopCodeOrTesterSerialNumberDataIdentifier | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF199         | programmingDateDataIdentifier                    | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF1F0         | systemSupplierCBIdentification                   | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF1F1         | systemSupplierBootCtrlIdentification             | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF18C         | ECUSerialNumberDataIdentifier                    | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF18A         | SystemSupplierIdentifier                         | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF192         | SystemSupplierECUHardwareNumberIdentifier        | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF19E         | ODX File Identifier                              | yes     | yes         | yes                 | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xFE00         | CB-ME Diagnosis Info                             | yes     | no          | no                  | Not Required   |
+----------------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+

# The below DIDs are supported by CB-ME for the WriteDataByIdentifier (SID: 0x2E) service:   {#the-below-dids-are-supported-by-cb-me-for-the-writedatabyidentifier-sid-0x2e-service .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}

+--------+--------------------------------------------------+---------------------------------------------+----------------+
| DID    | Description                                      | Session                                     | Security Level |
|        |                                                  +---------+-------------+---------------------+                |
|        |                                                  | Default | Programming | Extended Diagnostic |                |
+========+==================================================+=========+=============+=====================+================+
| 0xF198 | repairShopCodeOrTesterSerialNumberDataIdentifier | no      | yes         | yes                 | L1             |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+
| 0xF199 | programmingDateDataIdentifier                    | no      | yes         | yes                 | L1             |
+--------+--------------------------------------------------+---------+-------------+---------------------+----------------+

 

For more information on the encoding of standard DIDs, you can refer [Standard DIDs](standard-dids.html){.topiclink}.
